text:
Silver Price in 1984
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1984, the LBMA silver price fell 25.4% between 1984-01-31 ($8.43) and 1984-12-31 ($6.29). The highest sampled price was $9.65 in March and the lowest was $6.29 in December. The mean of these observations was $8.06. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
